# 🧰 Engineering Templates

Reusable templates for design reviews and operations. Copy the template into the relevant issue, pull request, or documentation folder and remove sections that do not apply.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Decision Record](adr.md) | Record context, options, decision, trade-offs |
| [Security Review](security-review.md) | Threats, boundaries, mitigations, evidence |
| [Incident Review](incident-review.md) | Timeline, impact, cause, corrective actions |
| [Release Checklist](release-checklist.md) | Verify release readiness and rollback |
| [Service Runbook](runbook.md) | Operate and troubleshoot a service |

Use the GitHub issue forms in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE for bug, feature, and documentation submissions.
